calls.statement:
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-10-04') AS lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_keys,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_ids,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_returns,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_orders,
 (SELECT sum(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30') AS rpt_calendar_sept,
 (SELECT sum(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS rpt_p5,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status='processing' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-28') AS processing_old,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=999 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS s999_lines
